## Methods

Set intersections among 4 sets (apoptosis, inflammation, metabolism, cell_cycle) across 72 elements were drawn as an UpSet plot with ComplexHeatmap. The plot shows the 15 observed intersections and each set's total size; it is descriptive, so no statistical test is applied. Rendered in R 4.4.1 with ComplexHeatmap 2.22.0.

## Plot configuration

The complete plot configuration is in `plot_config.yaml`.
